voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Palermo, Sicily. October, nineteen sixty-nine. Above the altar of the Oratory of San Lorenzo hung Caravaggio's Nativity, nearly nine feet tall.
One night, thieves cut the canvas from its frame and took it away.
The FBI named it one of its top ten art crimes.
Over the years, investigators were told it was burned. Hidden in a barn. Sold abroad. None of it led to the painting.
Today a copy hangs in its place. The original has never been found.
